description: Two logical inverters with voltage control over whether each one inverts, A and B

inputs.text: The signal that half converts to a gate and then inverts or passes; over 2V counts as high. With nothing patched here that half's OUT is 0V, and the channels patched here set its polyphony
A gate held high here makes that half invert; held low it makes that half pass its input through as a gate. With nothing patched the half inverts

outputs.text: 10V or 0V, that half's input read as a gate and then inverted or passed according to its INVERT input
